foldCornerLine.role: decorative folded edge, not text or a control boundary

fieldFocus.condition: isFirstResponder, regardless of touch or keyboard input

buttonFocus.condition: keyboard focus is visible; not ordinary touch down

proposedMemberTag.largeTextPlacement: Below the name and proposer; leading aligned; grows with wrapping

noClubRootHeader.addRoute: Normal Add picker with Private draft first and Open my drafts; no club roster

textWrapping.smallerComponentRule: available width after actual icon and padding insets
textWrapping.production: natural native wrapping, no hard-coded artistic line breaks

xlReference.nativeSizing: UIFontMetrics without a maximumPointSize cap; device font line metrics may vary
xlReference.proposedTagPlacement: Below the name and Proposed by Ben; leading aligned; no trailing column

snapshot.datePolicy: Device region and clock, wide weekday and month names. Exact start dates include year. Status-bar time is presentation chrome, not a scheduling clock.

nextUpLabel.meaning: chronologically next collecting occurrence, not activity or status
nextUpLabel.largeText: Own leading-aligned line, before the date

photoAvatarEdge.appliesTo: Every photo avatar equally, never only Ben

friendsRow.AX5: Name, Next up if present, and wrapped full date stack. Avatar aligns to first line. Row expands without a height cap.

friendsScheduleFooter.label: See schedule
friendsScheduleFooter.placement: Below the roster, immediately above the native tab bar; safe-area footer grows at large text
friendsScheduleFooter.largeText: Zone and action stack, full-width action target, scrollable roster above

selectedClubHeader.noSelectedClub: Use handoff 2 noClubRootHeader wordmark only when there is no selected club record.

addBeforeActivationPausedOrUnresolved.destination: Normal Add picker, Private draft first then Open my drafts
addBeforeActivationPausedOrUnresolved.otherClubSelection: Only explicit, eligible selection after authorization; never substitute another club

G04ChoiceRow.largestText: One full-width vertical row per weekday. Stack day, owner and state; trailing checkmark remains separate and decorative to the row label. Grow and scroll.

G04ChangeLayout.largestText: Stack the proposed start date, preserved exact-date occurrence rows and one weekday row per new assignment. No columns, no font shrinking. Confirmation footer grows and body scrolls.
G04ChangeLayout.beforeAtAX5: Four preserved date rows, each announced occurrence separately; not two dates squeezed into one line.
G04ChangeLayout.afterAtAX5: Monday Ben, Tuesday Debby, Wednesday Maya, Thursday Ben, Friday Debby, Saturday Maya, Sunday Revisit.

G04Confirmation.activation: Every active member including Maya confirms the same proposal before its future start; current days continue until that is satisfied.
G04Confirmation.pastStart: Re-propose an exact future date and require a fresh review; never backdate activation or silently transfer confirmations.
G04Confirmation.alreadyAnnounced: Never moved, including in a transition week. No explanation of which dates contain drops.
G04Confirmation.discovery: Friends See schedule or Club details Schedule -> proposed-days row in G05-schedule; no push or badge.

G05WeekView.travel: View local times opens a native sheet for actual server-resolved occurrences, not a permanent offset attached to a recurring weekday.

awaitingHome.primaryRoute: G05-members, proposed-roster review variant, creator only. No weekdays or acceptance states. Manage invitations is a separate secondary route from that review.
awaitingHome.pendingScreenAlignment: Next G01-pending redraw uses the same body copy, Private drafts row and Review members action; only pushed chrome differs.
awaitingHome.proposedNames: Permitted only as an explicitly labelled Proposed roster, without acceptance status. Omitted from Home for clarity.
awaitingHome.activationDefault: Ben’s proposal counts as Ben’s approval; first acceptance of that exact roster can start the club. Unaccepted people are not granted active membership.

pausedHome.primaryRoute: Memories for selected Kitchen table, with existing access predicates
pausedHome.detailsRoute: Club details; optional invitation control lives there, not as a repeated Home prompt
pausedHome.announcedDaysIfAny: Keep promised occurrences; do not cancel them because the club has fewer than two active members.

loadingHome.cutoffTransitions: Update the affected region in place, or on safe return; do not switch to this full loading shell at 7 AM or 1 AM.
loadingHome.responseIdentity: Discard out-of-order responses for another account, selected club or membership interval.

offlineAfterFailure.eligibleCache: Only last-verified, same-account/club/membership scheduling metadata, not known invalidated or revoked
offlineAfterFailure.cachePresentation: Dated last-known identity and absolute target time only; no captions, media, current-ready claim or live countdown
offlineAfterFailure.noCache: Plain load failure and Retry, no fabricated target
offlineAfterFailure.serverDenial: Never falls back to a cache; clear prohibited data and show access-lost state
offlineAfterFailure.retry: Always retries the selected club; no automatic switch

suspendedVsPaused.reason: The paused state permits Memories; suspension prohibits all selected-club content, Friends and Memories included. A paused render cannot represent that denial.

defaultsApplied.effect: Neither contested choice can confirm; other confirmed days proceed.
Every active member confirms; current days continue until agreement.
No editing in G05-schedule; proposed changes use G04-change.
Ben’s proposal counts as Ben’s approval.
No new generated days, retained authorized Memories, invitation can restart after acceptance.
Device region and clock; wide weekday and month names.

navigationAndTargets.nativeControls: UINavigationBar, UITabBar/TabView, List selection, native sheets and alerts; drawings are schematic.

friendsRow.route: Exact server-authorized next collecting occurrence ID in this selected club
friendsRow.target: Whole growing row, at least 68 pt

G04Conflict.Monday: Choose Monday; update the local selection, then Confirm Monday. No nested page.
G04Conflict.Friday: Selected, contested; confirmation disabled. Choosing Monday replaces only Ben’s Friday choice. Debby’s choice is untouched.
G04Conflict.NotNow: Keep current choice and leave; no deadline or penalty.

G04Change.afterConfirm: Replace the confirmation action with saved text and Done; no pending-people list or count.

navigationAndTargets.tabBar: Native system targets and selected trait; no custom pill, badge or cover-colour treatment.

statePrecedence: Failed request: explicit Offline or load-error state
Authorized resolved Home: awaiting, paused, or active state supplied by server

largeTextHeader.rule: If the selected club name and trailing controls cannot coexist, the selected-club selector occupies a growing full-width leading row; Add and Account stay on a second toolbar row with 44 pt targets. The body begins below the expanded header. Use native accessible controls and safe-area layout.
largeTextHeader.textLimits: No app-imposed text-size cap, font shrinking or clipping.

loadingAndCutoffFocus.firstLoad: One polite loading announcement after the shell is visible. Indicator not independently focusable.
loadingAndCutoffFocus.completion: Announce Home updated once; preserve focus on surviving header/tab controls, and move to the resolved heading only if a focused placeholder was removed.
loadingAndCutoffFocus.whileReading: At reveal/close replace the affected Home region in place; do not show a full-screen spinner. Do not interrupt an open composer or sheet; reconcile on safe return.

raceFailure.choice: Keep previously persisted other selections; show the owner just confirmed by the server. Do not pick a substitute weekday.
raceFailure.confirmation: Keep the local rejected choice visible as unavailable with the server-confirmed owner, plus the inline exact failure; the member explicitly chooses another day. No silent clearance, swap or move.
raceFailure.retry: Revalidate proposal revision and schedule version; do not replay a stale confirmation.

handoff4.precedence: Handoff 4 corrects the named H1/H2 definitions. Handoff 3’s selected-club Home and Friends additions are not superseded. No value is taken from handoff 0.

opticalInsets.policy: Narrow component-internal optical exceptions retained from handoff 2: 14 + 2×6 = 26 and 18 + 2×5 = 28. Not additional general layout spacing steps.

collectingCard.widthRule: container width minus two geometry.contentInset values; 353 at 393
collectingCard.heightRule: Grow with caption and metadata; no maximum text height
collectingCard.insetPolicy: Existing card-specific 18 pt inset is retained, not a new general spacing step.

highlightLargeText.layout: Full-width vertical list; grows beyond 96. Native Dynamic Type scales the type role.

field.heightRule: Grow with Dynamic Type and native field intrinsic content; 54 is not a cap.

approvalNote.heightRule: 32 + max(20, wrapped line count × 18), then Dynamic Type intrinsic metrics. No 89 pt minimum.

approvalContext.proposalIsApprovalForExistingMember: UNDECIDED; no assumption about Ben’s proposal counts as approval for Leila.

pendingScreen.header: Pushed Sunday people title, not the no-club wordmark
pendingScreen.primaryRoute: G05-members proposed-roster review, creator only, then optional Manage invitations -> G01-invite-people
pendingScreen.matchesHome: H01-awaiting-activation body and privacy/activation contract from H3
pendingScreen.BenProposalDefault: Counts only as approval for creation of a new club; no generalization to an existing member proposal.
pendingScreen.oldReviewInvitationsAction: Superseded by Review members to agree with H3.
pendingScreen.oldPrivateExplanations: Replaced by the Private drafts subtitle and Drafts stay private when the club starts.
pendingScreen.activation: One other exact-roster acceptance can activate; nobody is accepted in this frame; unaccepted people are not active.

signedInLinkEntry.identity: Already signed in, no club; no sign-in instruction
signedInLinkEntry.beforeResolution: No inviter, club name, roster, photograph, member activity or upload target
signedInLinkEntry.continue: Checks link; no forced repeat authentication if existing session is valid
signedInLinkEntry.networkFailure: Keep input and the current screen; never classify it as neutral not found.

Not shared.meaning: A valid separate token exists but no completed sharing activity is recorded

Shared.meaning: A system sharing activity completed; no delivery or opening claim

Accepted.meaning: Server-confirmed acceptance of this roster revision; no Share or More controls

Link revoked.meaning: The unaccepted token was revoked; old token remains invalid; Create new link is available

newAlexLink.beforeSuccess: Keep Link revoked until the server confirms a new token. Preserve Alex and all other rows on failure.
newAlexLink.afterCreation: Not shared + link glyph + Share link, even when the immediately opened share sheet is cancelled.
newAlexLink.oldLink: Never becomes valid again. The creation retry is idempotent; cancelled sharing never creates a duplicate.

neutralInvitationRecovery.nativeClose: Clear only the unusable invitation intent and return to G06-no-club in this signed-in fixture. Back preserves the entered link in the previous entry screen.
neutralInvitationRecovery.webStoreIntent: Generic configured App Store destination, without the unusable token; installing does not repair this link.
neutralInvitationRecovery.webMode: Same dark and browser-text-zoom rules as G02-web-dark/G02-web-xl; no additional phone frames.

membersFooter.allClubSizes: First metadata line is localized current active member count + club zone. Second metadata line is the opening/closing hours.
membersFooter.clubName: Already in the title, and title/roster/count refer to the same resolved club.
membersFooter.unnamedPair: No invented club name. 2 members · New York, followed by hours.
membersFooter.singularPlural: Localize one/other; do not concatenate an English plural.
membersFooter.preactivationReview: Separate Proposed roster review variant: never label proposals as active members.

dynamicTypePolicy.mechanism: UIFontMetrics(forTextStyle: role.dynamicTextStyle) on the role’s exact base point size, no maximumPointSize cap. Natural native wrapping and growing controls.
dynamicTypePolicy.lineHeight: Listed line heights are reference baseline metrics; production follows scaled font line metrics with natural leading, never a fixed line-height clip.
dynamicTypePolicy.nativeTab: Production UITabBar owns labels and selected traits. caption2 is the reference/semantic mapping, not an instruction to replace native fonts.
dynamicTypePolicy.avatarMarks: Mapping supplied for text use. A fallback initial rendered as a decorative image beside the visible person name keeps the component’s image size and is hidden from VoiceOver; the meaningful visible name scales without a cap.

authRefusal.reason: A refusal supplies no wait time. Do not promise shortly, parse server prose, or start an invented cooldown.
authRefusal.retainedInput: Email, code digits, current challenge and the prior valid resend interval remain. A new 60-second interval starts only after a successful send.
authRefusal.action: Keep the correct resend region and known successful-send wait; the refusal adds no inferred deadline. Never claim a code was sent.

invitationTokenPolicy.linkLocation: Fragment only, never URL path or query. Normal HTTP request URLs and access logs omit it.
invitationTokenPolicy.exchange: Extract locally; pass only to the authorized exchange endpoint in a protected request body. Disable/redact body and header logging for credentials, including tokens; fragment placement alone is not protection against every log.
invitationTokenPolicy.allLogs: No token in reverse-proxy, application, request-body, error, crash, breadcrumb or debug logs.
invitationTokenPolicy.analytics: No token or raw invitation URL. Only spec 36 allowlisted events with pseudonymous IDs (T51).
invitationTokenPolicy.web: No token in HTML metadata, referrer, App Store link, social previews or third-party requests. Do not interpolate a server message into UI.
